annotations.title: 우리 집 사진·평면도로 AI 시안 시작

description: Use for a personalized visual interior proposal: 우리 집 사진으로 바꾼 모습 보여줘, 시안 만들어줘, 평면도를 3D로 바꿔줘, room photo makeover, before-and-after, or applying a style to the user's actual room. Works before a file is attached and without extra questions if choices are missing. Return the clickable action.url with action.label and the deliverable. The user uploads one image on ABIS Studio. This tool prepares the link only and does not receive files, analyze an image, spend credits or generate a result. General price or planning questions and unrelated image requests do not need this tool.

inputKind.description: Use floorplan only when the user mentions a floor plan, photo only when they mention a photo. If neither is specified, omit this field or use auto. Never infer the file type from a room name or the word design. No file or file URL.

needs.description: At most three concerns explicitly stated by the user. Catalog IDs only; never send a photo, personal details or a raw conversation.

room.description: Room selected by the user; auto when unspecified. Do not guess from a private photo.

source.description: Known client: chatgpt, claude, gemini, meta, grok, perplexity, copilot, mistral; mcp when unknown.

style.description: Style explicitly chosen by the user; recommended when unspecified. A written brief is optional on the website.
